referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes the treatment of a used electric drivetrain of an electric passenger car. The original dataset has been developed for a 100kW drivetrain comprising an electric motor (53kg), a converter (4.5kg), an inverter (9.5kg), a power distribution unit (3.9kg), a charger and cables (3m). First, the drivetrain is manually dismantled to recover all large metal scrap, especially from the electric motror and from the cases of the electronic devices. The scrap steel, copper and aluminium directly recovered from the components is sent to the respective scrap recycling facilities, while the remaining electronics scrap is sent to a smelter facility. Information on the materialisation of the dismatled components are in F. Habermacher "Modeling material inventories and environmental impacts of electric passenger cars", Matser Thesis, Department of Environmental Sciences, ETH Zurich, 2011.; UUID: cbaefd7f-b375-321c-a535-16c618ef9d29
